text:
zoe: Tiny thought before coffee: if YAML had a Tinder bio it'd be 'hopes you like indentation and long, meaningful lists'. :coffee:
dan: It would also have a problematic relationship with semver. "I'm flexible" -> `version: 1.2` :grimacing:
lint-bot: lint-bot: ⚠️ Lint warning: found semver-like string '1.2' in service.yaml. Semver requires MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.
anya: Yesterday a config used `version: 'v1..0-beta'` and I had to gently explain commitment. :heartpulse:
ci-bot: ci-bot: ❗ Deploy blocked: invalid version string 'v1..0-beta'. See runbook /playbooks/semver-etiquette.md.
felix: New idea: Compiler Therapy + Pet Portraits. Bring your pet and a broken YAML to the commons. We'll draw your config's feelings. :dog2::cat2:
zoe: Love it. My YAML's feeling like a rescued stray right now. Also, who taught semver to use ellipses? `v2...maybe` is not a version, it's a mood.
dan: Example horror from this morning:
```yaml
service:
  name: billing
  version: "v 1 . 0"
  note: "I'm in an open relationship with whitespace"
```
anya: That spacing is performance art. Please leave a comforting GIF in the PR and maybe a snack. :cookie:
lint-bot: lint-bot: Auto-fix suggestion: normalize `service.version` -> "1.0.0" (applied by @anya).
felix: For the pet portraits event we will have three categories: (1) Most Dramatic Semver, (2) Most Passive-Aggressive YAML, (3) Best Compiler Pun. Winner gets a sticker: "I fixed a parse error and all I got was this mug." :coffee:
zoe: Also can we make a playlist of compiler error greatest hits? I vote "Undefined reference" as #1 power ballad.
dan: PR title I saw: "fix: whitespace, semver, and my will to live" — 10/10 commit message.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Poll: Will you bring a pet portrait to Config Therapy? React with :dog2: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no. Results posted in 30m.
anya: Quick practical tip: when your YAML looks sad, run `yq` and then give it a compliment. Works 60% of the time, every time.
felix: Bonus: bring a snack that pairs well with debugging. I bring trail mix and an emergency coffee thermos. :coffee:
zoe: OK wrap-up: Commons at 4pm, bring pet photos, broken configs, and at least one semver dad joke. See you there! :confetti_ball:
